prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Content Creation Services
I am looking to engage content creation services for road safety education aimed towards an NSW Government & local council audience. Our office is based in Sydney Australia. Would suit someone in Sydney with access to our Barangaroo offices for fortnightly updates. The deadline for the whole project would be June 2023. Cheers Stever Kustro SMK Creative Group Pty Ltd
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by briefly introducing yourself.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi Stever,

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience working with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’m interested in your content creation services project for road safety education. While my background is in development, I’m comfortable collaborating on clear, audience-focused digital content and helping shape materials that are practical, accessible, and easy to manage across web experiences. I work well with structured feedback cycles and can support fortnightly updates as needed.

If you’re looking for someone who can contribute reliably and communicate clearly with your team, I’d be glad to discuss how I can help support the project through to the June 2023 deadline.

Best,
Tobias Reyne
